rationale: Cancelled by the driver as a rider no-show, so NS-0 routes to NS-1/NS-2. The driver tapped 'I'm Here' at 08:16:00 but the GPS shows him parked 612 m from the pickup from 08:13 until cancellation, never within the 200 m arrival radius (the platform recorded no arrival). NS-1 element (ii) fails, so the $6.61 cancellation fee is refunded in full (NS-2). Because the driver indicated arrival while not at the pickup, add flag_account (NS-2: abuse of the cancellation/waiting button). The driver's 'Victoria Street was jammed solid' claim is contradicted by speed band 3 (20-29 km/h, slow but moving) and by the GPS, which shows him parked on Stamford Road rather than crawling on Victoria Street.
